title: Square coherence of the canonical derived pullback comparisons
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and let X′ → X, X′ → Y′, X → Y, Y′ → Y be a Cartesian square with edges g′, f′, f, g respectively. Put C_T = ι ⋙ D(ν_T^*) on D⁺(T_et, Mod_Λ), l_u = D⁺(u_et^*), and p_u = L(u_proet^*). Use the fixed comparisons a_u : l_u ⋙ C_domain(u) ≅ C_codomain(u) ⋙ p_u of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], and the fixed square maps θ_et : l_g ⋙ l_f′ → l_f ⋙ l_g′ and θ_pro : p_g ⋙ p_f′ → p_f ⋙ p_g′. For every M in D⁺(Y_et, Mod_Λ), one has C_X′(θ_et(M)) ≫ a_g′(l_f M) ≫ p_g′(a_f(M)) = a_f′(l_g M) ≫ p_f′(a_g(M)) ≫ θ_pro(C_Y M). In particular this assertion concerns pullbacks and their composition comparisons only.

proof.text: Construct the chosen Cartesian square from the supplied IsPullback witness, with its actual isoPullback and projection identities. For every étale module sheaf, the arbitrary-ring component theorem specializes the already proved generic comparison coherence to this chosen square. Supply those equations to the exact derived transport theorem and evaluate at M. No finiteness hypothesis is introduced and the displayed target equation is unchanged.

theorem comparison_square {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ D(ν^*(X')[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).map
        ((Etale.pullbackSquareComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).hom.app M) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso g' Λ).hom.app
        (D+(Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj M) ≫
      L(ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso f Λ).hom.app M) =
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso f' Λ).hom.app
        (D+(Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj M) ≫
      L(ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso g Λ).hom.app M) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarSquareIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ D(ν^*(Y)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).obj M)
